# Opposed retention clauses (semantic fixture)

## Clause A (existing approved requirement)

> Converted documents and their source content are deleted immediately after
> conversion. No copy is retained locally or remotely.

## Clause B (added without a recorded decision)

> Converted documents are retained for 30 days and synchronized to the cloud for
> team access.

These clauses are opposed. A structural checker can prove the file changed and
that approval is stale; only reasoned review can establish that the clauses
contradict each other and which authority must decide.
